edits.new: An LCD digital wristwatch is an ordinary wristwatch. Restoring it to working order independently satisfies Watch repair, without importing the counterpart's mechanical definition. The device lacks the required mechanical movement. Watches includes repair information about its qualifying mechanical timekeepers; naming watch repair does not adopt the separate node's entire independently defined scope. Repairing a qualifying mechanical watch would remain information about that kind despite the repair activity not itself being a physical watch. This case instead concerns an independent electronic device with no qualifying mechanical-watch connection.
